title: On the Isomorphism of Semicircular Algebras
summary: Building on OpenAI's proof of isomorphism of free group factors, we give a self-contained proof of a corresponding result for $C^{*}$-algebras generated by free semicircular systems: the isomorphism class of a $C^{*}$-algebra generated by a semicircular $n$-tuple does not depend on $n\in\{2,3,\dots,+\infty\}$. Similarly, reduced free products of $n$ copies of the Jiang--Su algebra are isomorphic for different $n$ in this range.
